description: Example divergence gate configuration. Copy this file and customize the fingerprints list based on your design identity document's banned patterns.

fingerprints.label: banned-font:Inter
fingerprints.rationale: Inter is the most common AI-default body font.

fingerprints.label: default-color:indigo-600
fingerprints.rationale: Tailwind indigo-600 is the most common AI-default accent.

fingerprints.label: default-color:purple-blue-gradient
fingerprints.rationale: Purple-to-blue gradient heroes are a slop fingerprint.

fingerprints.label: hardcoded-hex-color
fingerprints.rationale: All colors should reference design tokens, not raw hex.

fingerprints.label: hardcoded-font-family
fingerprints.rationale: Font declarations should use design tokens.

fingerprints.label: banned-naming:utils
fingerprints.rationale: Generic module naming. Use domain-specific names.

fingerprints.label: banned-naming:helpers
fingerprints.rationale: Generic module naming. Use domain-specific names.
